summary: Surveyed all 628 listed files (all .lean, all present in reservoir-sources/QudeLeap__Lean-QuantumAlg, 5,057,880 bytes total; sizes 289 to 73,564 bytes) under QuantumAlg/Components. A line-start declaration grep found 612 files with theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque declarations. Of the 16 without a match, 1 (QuditShift/Reset/Circuit/Sequence.lean) holds `public def` declarations the regex missed, 1 (Oracle.lean) holds an empty section/end block, and 14 hold only imports plus module docstrings. The import-only re-export headers stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 because no verified auxiliary query channel exists for them. No file is generated data, benchmark output, or duplicated content. Disposition: retain all files.
